1.1: Hamechannes challot al menat lehaferish, venashchu, bet shammay omrim, chibbur bitvul yom. uvet hillel omrim, eno chibbur. mikratzot noshchot zo vazo, vechikkarot noshchot zo vazo, haofe chamita al gabbe chamita ad shello karmu vattannur, vekolit shel mayim hamechulchelet, uretichat gerisin shel pol rishona, uretichat yayin chadash, rabbi yehuda omer, af shel orez, bet shammay omrim, chibbur bitvul yom. bet hillel omrim, eno chibbur. umodim bishar kol hattumot, ben kallot ben chamurot:
1.2: Hamechannes challot al menat shello lehaferish, haofe chamita al gabbe chamita mishshekkarmu vattannur, vekolit shel mayim sheenah mechulchelet, uretichat gerisin shel pol sheniyya, uretichat yayin yashan, veshel shemen leolam, veshel adashim, rabbi yehuda omer, af shel tofach, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot:
1.3: Masmer sheachar hakkikkar, vegarger melach katan, vecharchur pachut mikkaetzba, rabbi yose omer, kol shehu neechol alav, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot:
1.4: Hatztzeror shebbakkikkar, vegarger melach gadol, vehatturmos, vehacharchur yater mikkaetzba, rabbi yose omer, kol sheeno neechol immo, tehorim beav hattuma, veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom:
1.5: Hasseora vehakkussemet bizman sheenan kelufim, hattia vehachiltit vehaalum, rabbi yehuda omer, af afunim shechorim, tehorim beav hattuma, veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, tehorim bitvul yom, utemeim bechol hattumot. hasseora vehakkussemet bizman shehen kelufim, vehachitta ben shehi kelufa ben sheenah kelufa, hakketzach, vehashshumshom, vehappilpel, rabbi yehuda omer, af afunim levanim, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot:

2.1: Mashke tevul yom, kemashkin shehu nogea bahen. ellu vaellu, enan metammein. ushear kol hattemein, ben kallin ben chamurin, hammashkin hayyotzim mehen, kammashkin shehu nogea bahen. ellu vaellu techilla, chutz min hammashke shehu av hattuma:
2.2: Kedera shehi melea mashkim venaga bah tevul yom, im haya mashke teruma, hammashkin pesulin vehakkedera tehora. veim haya mashke chullin, hakkol tahor. veim hayu yadav mesoavot, hakkol tame. ze chomer bayyadayim mibbitvul yom. vechomer bitvul yom mibbayyadayim, shessefek tevul yom posel et hatteruma, vehayyadayim sefekan tahor:
2.3: Hammikpa shel teruma vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin, shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan, pasal et kullam. hammikpa shel chullin vehashshum vehashshemen shel teruma, shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan, lo fasal ella mekom maggao. veim haya hashshum merubbe, holchin achar harov. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehen gush bakkeara. aval im haya mefuzzar bammedocha, tahor, mippene shehu rotze befizzuro. ushear kol hanniddochin sheddachan bemashkin. aval et sheddarkan laduch bemashkim vedachan shello vemashkin vehen gush bakkeara, hare ellu cheiggul shel devela:
2.4: Hammikpa vehachamita shel chullin vehashshemen shel teruma tzaf al gabbehen, venaga tevul yom bashshemen, lo fasal ella hashshemen. veim chibbetz, kol makom sheholech hashshemen, pasal:
2.5: Besar hakkodesh shekkaram alav hakkippa, naga tevul yom bakkippa, chatichot muttarot. naga bachaticha, chaticha vechol haolim immah, chibbur ze laze. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shenehem chibbur ze laze. vechen bekitniyyot shekkarmu al gabbe ferusot. maase kedera vakkitniyyot, bizman shehen perudim, enan chibbur. bizman shehen gush, chibbur. im hayu gushin harebe, hare ellu yimmanu. shemen shehu tzaf al gabbe hayyayin venaga tevul yom bashshemen, lo fasal ella hashshemen. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shenehem chibbur ze laze:
2.6: Chavit sheshshaka letoch bor shel yayin venaga bo tevul yom, missafa velifnim, chibbur. min hassafa velachutz, eno chibbur. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, afillu al gabbah rum koma venaga keneged piha, chibbur:
2.7: Chavit shennikkeva ben mippiha ben mishshuleha ben mitztziddeha venaga bo tevul yom, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, mippiha umishshuleha, temea. min hatztzedadin, mikkan umikkan, tehora. hameare mikkeli lichli venaga tevul yom bakkilluach, im yesh bo, yaale veachat umea:
2.8: Bibua shebbechavit shennikkav ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz uven milmalan ben millemattan, ze cheneged ze, tame veav hattuma vetame veohel hammet. happenimi millematta vehachitzon milmalan, tame veav hattuma vetame veohel hammet. happenimi milmalan vehachitzon millemattan, tahor beav hattuma vetame veohel hammet:

3.1: Kol yedot hoochalim shehem chibbur beav hattuma, chibbur bitvul yom. ochel shennifras umeore miktzat, rabbi meir omer, im ochez baggadol vehakkatan ole immo, hare hu chamohu. rabbi yehuda omer, im ochez bakkatan vehaggadol ole immo, hare hu chamohu. rabbi nechemya omer, battahor. vachachamim omrim, battame. ushear kol hoochalim, et sheddarko leachez beale, ochez oto beale. uvakkelach, ochazin oto bakkalach:
3.2: Yarak shel teruma uvetza terufa netuna al gabbav, venaga tevul yom babbetza, lo fasal ella hakkelach shekkenegdo. rabbi yose omer, kol hasseder haelyon. im haya chemin kova, enah chibbur:
3.3: Chut shel betza shekkaram al defanot shel lefas, venaga bo tevul yom, min hassafa velifnim, chibbur. min hassafa velachutz, eno chibbur. rabbi yose omer, chut vechol shenniklaf immo. vechen bekitniyyot shekkarmu al sefatah shel kedera:
3.4: Issa shennidmea o shennitchammetza visor shel teruma, enah nifselet bitvul yom. rabbi yose verabbi shimon poslin. issa shehuchshera vemashke venillosha beme ferot venaga bahen tevul yom, rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, pasal et kullah. rabbi akiva omer mishshemo, lo fasal ella mekom maggao:
3.5: Yarak shel chullin shebbishshelo veshemen shel teruma, venaga bo tevul yom, rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, pasal kullah. rabbi akiva omer mishshemo, lo fasal ella mekom maggao:
3.6: Tahor shennagas min haochel venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. haya ochel zetim petzuim utemarim retubbot, kol shehu rotze lamotz et garinato venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tame. haya ochel zetim neguvin utemarim yeveshot, kol sheeno rotze lamotz et garinato venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. echad tahor veechad tevul yom, kaellu. rabbi meir omer, ellu vaellu temein bitvul yom, shemmashkin shel tame machshirin lirtzono veshello lirtzono. vachachamim omrim, en tevul yom tame:

4.1: Ochel maaser shehuchshar bemashke, venaga bo tevul yom o yadayim mesoavot, mafrishin mimmennu terumat maaser betohora, mippene shehu shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin:
4.2: Haishsha shehi tevulat yom, lasha et haissa, vekotza lah challa umafrashtah, umannachtah bichfisha mitzrit o vinchuta, umakkefet vekora lah shem, mippene shehi shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin:
4.3: Areva shehi tevulat yom, lashin bah et haissa vekotzin mimmenna challa, umakkefet vekorin lah shem, mippene shehi shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin:
4.4: Lagin shehu tevul yom, umilahu min hechavit maaser tevel, im amar, hare zo terumat maaser mishshettechshach, hare zo terumat maaser. im amar, hare ze eruv, lo amar kelum. nishbera hechavit, hallagin betivlo. nishbar hallagin, hechavit betivlah:
4.5: Barishona hayu omrim, mechallelin al perot am haaretz. chazru lomar, af al meotav. barishona hayu omrim, hayyotze vakkolar veamar, kitvu get leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar, af hamefaresh vehayyotze vishyara. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hamesukkan:
4.6: Hakkaddumin haashkelonim shennishberu veunkeli shellahem kayyemet, hare ellu temein. hammaber vehammazre vehammaggov vechen masrek shel rosh shennittela achat mishshinnehen vaasaan shel mattachot, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yehoshua, davar chadash chiddeshu hassofrim veen li ma lehashiv:
4.7: Hattorem et habbor veamar, hare zo teruma al menat shettaale shalom, shalom min hashshever umin hashsheficha, aval lo min hattuma. rabbi shimon omer, af min hattuma. nishbera, enah medammaat. ad hechan tishshaver velo tedammea. kede shettitgalgel vetaggia labbor. rabbi yose omer, af mi shehaya vo daat lehatenot velo hitna, nishbera, enah medammaat, mippene shehu tenay bet din:
